Sam (CS): EmeraldCare returned the vendor risk form but left the DPA unsigned and did not attach SOC2 evidence. They listed 'BYOK' but no KMS vendor.

Olga (Legal): Default to Redwood DPA v3. If they propose term changes capture redlines and short risk note.

Sam (CS): Draft to customer: please attach signed Redwood DPA (v3) and either SOC2 AOC or report for last 12 months; confirm KMS/HSM vendor and key rotation cadence; share simple data flow diagram and retention policy excerpt. We can provide SFTP.

SecOpsBot: Reminder: "EmeraldCare" has 4 outstanding items. Assigned Sam (CS). Deadline: 2025-05-20.

Sam (CS): Sent. Will upload to /shared/customer-evidence/EmeraldCare when received.

EmeraldCare (reply): Uploaded SOC2 Type 2 (2024) and confirmed AWS KMS. DPA unsigned  they requested a minor SLA timing tweak.

Olga (Legal): SOC2 Type 2 OK. SLA tweak needs review; route redlines to Legal with a 1-paragraph business impact.

AM-Tyler: Noted renewal check in 6 weeks. Mark renewal risk in Gainsight if DPA still outstanding after Legal review.

SecOpsBot: Evidence upload detected: /shared/customer-evidence/EmeraldCare/soc2_2024_type2.pdf

Sam (CS): Uploaded SOC2 and KMS note. Routing SLA redline to Legal and will update Gainsight once we have their decision.
